key_idea: Recasting the problem from sets to random variables using an entropic Ruzsa distance, allowing the submodularity of Shannon entropy to drive a cleanly structured induction.
reason: The proof completely bypasses the intricate combinatorial machinery previously used for this problem, instead reducing it to an elegant sequence of information-theoretic inequalities. The conceptual shift to entropy replaces difficult set-theoretic bounds with simple, highly reusable manipulations, resulting in a true book proof.
recognized: Proof of the Polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa (PFR) conjecture over F_2^n by Gowers, Green, Manners, Tao
